title: Aries, you shot your shot
old_caption: They said no, and it stings. A no is information, not a judgement on who you are. Asking was brave, and brave is the win. Send this to the friend who just asked.

title: Taurus, step away from the old photos
old_caption: 2 a.m., the old album, the ache. Missing them doesn't mean you should go back. It means it mattered, and that's allowed. Now water, sleep, and breakfast tomorrow.

title: Gemini, close some tabs
old_caption: First-date nerves the night before? You don't need a script. Curiosity is your best outfit, so bring one real question and let the rest of the tabs close.

title: Leo, you shine with no applause
old_caption: Feeling invisible to your crush hurts. You don't have to perform to matter, and the right person notices the quiet you too. Notice yourself first.

title: Libra, a kind no is allowed
old_caption: Saying yes to a date you don't want helps no one. 'No, thank you' is a full sentence, and kind and honest fit in one text. Save this for the next invite.

title: Scorpio, say the soft thing
old_caption: Typed 'I like you', deleted it, sent 'lol'? Walls keep out the right people too. Soft isn't weak, it's brave. Say it once, plainly.

title: Sagittarius, unpack the suitcase
old_caption: Liking someone and wanting to run at the same time is so human. Liking someone isn't a cage. Tell them you're a little scared; honesty makes room to stay.

title: Capricorn, close the laptop
old_caption: Cancelling plans for 'one more email' again? Rest isn't a prize you have to earn, and you're wanted, not just useful. Say yes to one slow evening this week.

title: Aquarius, your weird is the point
old_caption: Ever felt like nobody gets you? Don't sand yourself down to fit a room. Your people are out there being weird too, so go where your weird is welcome.

title: Pisces, keep some for you
old_caption: For the friend who gives everyone everything: your big heart isn't the problem. It just lives in you too. Keep one piece for yourself tonight.
